hero.headlineStart: Close to the people you love,
hero.subheadline: Famicare connects families with their older adults through real-time location, safe zones and timely alerts, without taking away their independence.
hero.imageAlt: An older father out for a walk with his daughter

features.titleStart: More peace of mind for you.
features.subtitle: The essential information, without the hassle. Famicare brings together the tools your network needs to give better support.

location.title: Real-time location
location.description: See where your loved one is and review their recent activity on a clear, accessible map.

safeZones.title: Safe zones
safeZones.description: Set up trusted places and get an alert whenever your loved one enters or leaves them.

alerts.title: Alerts that matter
alerts.description: Get notified when they leave a zone, stay inactive for too long, or press the help button.

careNetwork.title: Care network
careNetwork.description: Invite relatives and caregivers to coordinate responsibilities from one place.

howItWorks.subtitle: Designed for real families: simple setup, easy-to-understand information and actionable notices.

steps.title: Create your network
steps.text: Add your loved one and invite the people involved in their care.

steps.title: Link the device
steps.text: Connect the IoT bracelet or pendant with GPS and a help button.

steps.title: Stay by their side, calmly
steps.text: Check their location and get notified only when they really need you.

clientFeatures.subtitle: No hard-to-read data. Every screen prioritizes what you need to know right now and who can help.
points: Device status and battery always in view.
Clear roles for relatives and caregivers.
Location and activity history in one place.

dashboard.label: Overview
dashboard.noticeText: The care network is already aware.

opensource.title: Open to move forward together.
opensource.text: Famicare is an open source project under development. We build transparently so the community can review, learn and contribute to more human care technology.
opensource.note: Soon we will share the public repository and the contribution guide.

aboutTeam.text: We are a Peruvian startup building accessible care and safety solutions for older adults, focused on families' peace of mind and respect for each person's autonomy.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To provide peace of mind through inclusive, easy-to-use technology.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To be a reference in connected care across Latin America.

success.title: Thanks for joining.
success.text: We'll let you know when there's news about Famicare.

footer.description: Care and safety technology to support with peace of mind and respect autonomy.
footer.tagline: Designed with respect, clarity and care.
